# EGT B2B API — Developer Guide (v1)

**Authoritative contract:** `packages/shared/openapi.yaml` (backend-owned, generated by
`npm run openapi:export` → `scripts/export-openapi.ts`).
This document is a human-readable guide to that contract. Where this document and the YAML
disagree, **the YAML wins** — regenerate it after any controller/DTO change.

**Status:** backend implemented and smoke-tested against local Postgres 16 (2026-09-25).
Not production-deployed. Base URLs are placeholders until infra is chosen (needs-from-Sukh).

---

## 1. Versioning

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Base path (server-enforced) | `/api/v1` — set via `app.setGlobalPrefix('api/v1')` in `apps/backend/src/main.ts` |
| Contract version | `1.0.0` (`openapi.yaml` `info.version`) |
| Interactive docs | `GET /api/docs` (Swagger UI, served by the API itself) |
| Compatibility policy | No breaking changes within v1 without Sukh's sign-off; breaking changes → new `/api/v2` prefix. Non-breaking additions (new fields, new endpoints) are allowed under v1. |
| `servers:` entry in spec | **Empty** — the spec deliberately declares no host; clients supply the base URL per environment (see §2). |

## 2. Base URL configuration

| Client | How the base URL is set | Values today |
|---|---|---|
| Mobile (`apps/mobile`) | Per-flavor `AppConfig.baseUrl` (`lib/src/core/config/app_config.dart`) | dev: `https://dev-api.eaglegoodstrading.com/api/v1` · staging: `https://staging-api.eaglegoodstrading.com/api/v1` · prod: `https://api.eaglegoodstrading.com/api/v1` |
| Admin (`apps/admin`) | `VITE_API_URL` env var (see `src/api/client.ts`) | defaults to `/api/v1` (same-origin reverse-proxy assumption) |

⚠️ **All three mobile hostnames are placeholders — no DNS, TLS certificate, or server
exists behind them.** Deploying the backend and wiring these URLs is a needs-from-Sukh
item (server infra decision). The admin's same-origin default means it must be served
behind a reverse proxy that forwards `/api/v1/*` to the NestJS API in production.

## 3. Auth flow

Roles: `buyer`, `supplier`, `staff`, `admin` (guests = unauthenticated). All auth
endpoints are `POST /api/v1/auth/*` unless noted.

### 3.1 Register — `POST /api/v1/auth/register`

- Public. Accepts `email`, `password`, `fullName`, optional `phone`, `companyName`, optional `role`.
- **Role coercion (server-side):** only `buyer`/`supplier` are accepted; sending
  `role: "admin"` (or any staff/admin value) silently creates a **buyer**.
  (Covered by unit test.)
- Password policy (enforced by `RegisterDto`): min **10** chars, max 128,
  must include upper + lower case, a digit, and a symbol. Passwords are hashed with
  **argon2id** (see `User.passwordHash`).
- Duplicate email → `409 EMAIL_TAKEN`.
- Returns a **verification token** (tokenized email link). ⚠️ The email is **not
  actually sent** — SMTP is not configured; the token is currently only logged
  (`TODO` in `auth.service.ts`). Users cannot self-verify until SMTP lands (needs-from-Sukh).

### 3.2 Verify email — `POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email`

- Body: `{ token }`. Unknown/expired token → `400`. Sets `User.emailVerifiedAt`.

### 3.3 Login — `POST /api/v1/auth/login`

- Body: `{ email, password }`. Response: `{ accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }`
  (exact response shape is **undeclared in the spec** — see §8).
- Access token: JWT, 15 minutes (`ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS=900`), claims
  `sub`, `role`, `tokenVersion`. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- Refresh token: opaque 30-day (`REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL_DAYS=30`), single-use, stored
  **SHA-256 hashed** server-side in `RefreshToken` with a `familyId` chain.
- Failed logins increment `User.failedLoginCount`; **5 failures → 15-minute account
  lockout** (`lockedUntil`); success resets the counter.
- The access-token `role` claim is a hint only — `RolesGuard` re-resolves the role
  from the database on every request (unit-tested: client-sent roles never trusted).

### 3.4 Refresh — `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`

- Body: `{ refreshToken }`. Validates the hashed token → **rotates**: invalidates the
  old token (`rotatedAt` set), issues a new pair in the same family.
- **Reuse detection:** presenting an already-rotated token revokes the **entire token
  family**, locks the session (`revokedReason: 'refresh_token_reuse_detected'`),
  writes an audit entry (`metadata.reason: 'refresh_reuse'`), and forces re-login.
  (Covered by unit test.)
- Unknown token → `401`.

### 3.5 Logout — `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` / `POST /api/v1/auth/logout-all`

- `logout`: revokes the current session's token family. `logout-all`: revokes **every
  session** of the user (one login session per device; unit-tested).

### 3.6 Sessions — `GET /api/v1/auth/sessions`, `DELETE /api/v1/auth/sessions/{id}`

- List active sessions (device/user-agent/IP, expiry) and revoke one individually.
  Used by the "revoke user sessions" runbook (`docs/runbooks.md`).

### 3.7 Password reset — `POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password`, `POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password`

- `forgot-password` issues a single-use tokenized link (`VerificationToken`,
  purpose `password_reset`); `reset-password` consumes it. ⚠️ Same SMTP gap as
  verification: the email is not sent today — tokens are only logged.

### 3.8 `GET /api/v1/auth/me`

- Returns the current authenticated user (field names undeclared in spec).

### Token storage (clients)

- Mobile: access token in memory; refresh token in platform secure storage
  (Android Keystore / iOS Keychain via `flutter_secure_storage`). Never in
  SharedPreferences/UserDefaults.
- Admin: access token in memory; refresh token in `sessionStorage`
  (`src/api/client.ts`) — web-appropriate, cleared when the tab closes.
- Silent refresh on 401 (both clients). Admin signs out after 15 minutes idle.

## 4. Error envelope

Every error response has the shape `{ code, message, details? }`
(`AllExceptionsFilter`, `src/common/filters/all-exceptions.filter.ts`).
Messages are user-friendly; **stack traces and internals never leak to clients**
(500s map to `INTERNAL_ERROR` / "Something went wrong. Please try again.").

Common codes:

| HTTP | `code` | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | class-validator failures; `details` carries the field errors |
| 400 | `EMAIL_TAKEN` / others | domain errors carry a specific `code` in the thrown body |
| 401 | `UNAUTHENTICATED` / `TOKEN_INVALID` | missing/invalid/expired token |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` (+ domain codes) | RBAC denial; wrong owner; self-approval attempt |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | resource missing |
| 409 | `CONFLICT` / `EMAIL_TAKEN` | duplicate email; double quote-accept; concurrent state change |
| 422 | `UNPROCESSABLE` | illegal RFQ/status transition; expired quote |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` | throttler guard (see §6) |
| 5xx | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | friendly message only |

Validation errors return `code: "VALIDATION_ERROR"` with the array of field
messages in `details`.

## 5. Pagination

Backend list endpoints return `{ data, page, limit, total }`
(`apps/backend/README.md`). The spec marks list endpoints as paginated but
**publishes no envelope schema**, so the admin client (`getPaged` in
`src/api/client.ts`) accepts **either** a plain array **or** a paged object and
normalises to `{ items, total, page, pageSize }`. New clients must do the same
until the spec publishes response schemas.

Query params follow the convention `?page=1&limit=20` (or `pageSize` on the admin side).

## 6. Rate limiting

- Global `ThrottlerGuard` (`apps/backend/src/app.module.ts`): default
  **120 requests / 60 seconds** per client (`THROTTLE_DEFAULT_LIMIT=120`,
  `THROTTLE_DEFAULT_TTL=60`).
- Login endpoint is stricter: `@Throttle({ default: { limit: 10, ttl: 60 } })`
  (**10 login attempts / minute**) **plus** the 5-failure → 15-minute account
  lockout (§3.3).
- Exceeding the limit → `429 RATE_LIMITED` with the standard error envelope.

## 7. Endpoint reference (grouped by resource)

Source: `packages/shared/openapi.yaml` (63 paths / 76 operations, verified
2026-09-25 by parsing the YAML). **Zero response schemas are published** —
status codes and request DTOs are the only declared surface. Field names below
in italics are the documented intent, not the contract.

### 7.1 Auth (`/api/v1/auth/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/auth/register` | public | buyer/supplier only; role coerced |
| POST | `/auth/verify-email` | public | `{ token }` |
| POST | `/auth/login` | public | throttled 10/min; 5-fail lockout |
| POST | `/auth/refresh` | public | rotating refresh; reuse detection |
| POST | `/auth/logout` | auth | revokes token family |
| POST | `/auth/logout-all` | auth | revokes all sessions |
| GET | `/auth/sessions` | auth | list sessions |
| DELETE | `/auth/sessions/{id}` | auth | revoke one session |
| POST | `/auth/forgot-password` | public | email NOT sent (no SMTP) |
| POST | `/auth/reset-password` | public | `{ token, password }` |
| GET | `/auth/me` | auth | current user |

### 7.2 Users & companies

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET, PATCH | `/users/me` | auth | own profile |
| POST | `/companies` | auth | create company |
| GET | `/companies/mine` | auth | own company |
| POST | `/companies/mine/addresses` | auth | add address |
| PATCH, DELETE | `/companies/mine/addresses/{id}` | auth | edit/remove address |

### 7.3 Catalogue (`/api/v1/products/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET, POST | `/products` | public GET · staff/admin POST | list / create product |
| GET | `/products/categories` | public | category list |
| GET | `/products/{slug}` | public | product detail incl. specs/images |
| PATCH | `/products/{id}` | staff/admin | update |

Catalogue data is the 16 site-audited products only (seeded verbatim;
unverified compliance bullets deliberately excluded). **No prices are published**
— pricing happens via quotation, as on the live site.

### 7.4 Suppliers (`/api/v1/suppliers/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/suppliers/profile` | supplier | create supplier profile |
| GET | `/suppliers/me` | supplier | own profile |
| POST, GET | `/suppliers/me/listings` | supplier | submit/list own listings |
| GET | `/suppliers/pending` | staff/admin | review queue |
| PATCH | `/suppliers/listings/{id}/review` | staff/admin | approve/reject — **reviewer cannot approve own listing** (403, unit-tested); listings start `pending_review`, **never auto-published** |

### 7.5 RFQs (`/api/v1/rfqs/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST, GET | `/rfqs` | auth (buyer POST; scoped GET) | create (idempotency via atomic RFQ-number transaction) / list own |
| GET | `/rfqs/{id}` | owner/staff/admin | **buyers see only their own** (403 cross-buyer, unit-tested) |
| POST | `/rfqs/{id}/transition` | owner/staff/admin | state-machine transition; illegal jumps → 422 |

RFQ numbers are transactional yearly-sequential (`EGT-RFQ-2026-000001`),
allocated with an atomic UPSERT…RETURNING in the same transaction — no gaps on
retry, no collisions under concurrency.

Lifecycle (server-side state machine, `RfqStatus`):
`submitted → under_review → sourcing → supplier_matched → sample_discussion →
quotation_ready → buyer_action_required → approved → order_processing →
completed`, plus `closed` from early states. Every transition writes an audit
record and may emit a notification.

### 7.6 Private label (`/api/v1/private-label/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/private-label` | auth | create OEM request (attached to an RFQ) |
| GET | `/private-label/{id}` | owner/staff/admin | detail |
| POST | `/private-label/{id}/transition` | staff/admin | forward-only statuses: submitted → design_review → sample → approval → production → completed |

Note: `oem-private-label.php` returns HTTP 500 on the live website today; the
app flow is API-native and does not depend on the website page.

### 7.7 Notifications (`/api/v1/notifications/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/notifications` | auth | own notifications |
| GET | `/notifications/unread-count` | auth | badge count |
| PATCH | `/notifications/{id}/read` | auth | mark read |
| POST, DELETE | `/notifications/device-tokens` | auth | register/remove FCM token |
| GET | `/notifications/preferences` | auth | per-event preferences |
| PATCH | `/notifications/preferences/{eventType}` | auth | toggle one event type |

Event types: `rfq_status_changed`, `quote_available`,
`quote_revision_requested`, `order_status_changed`, `shipment_update`,
`document_uploaded`, `security_alert`, `ticket_reply`, `message_received`.
⚠️ Push fan-out today uses `LogPushProvider` (**logs only**); real FCM/APNs
needs keys (needs-from-Sukh).

### 7.8 Quotes (`/api/v1/quotes/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST, GET | `/quotes` | staff POST · scoped GET | create (staff) / list |
| POST | `/quotes/{id}/send` | staff | send to buyer |
| POST | `/quotes/{id}/accept` | buyer (owner) | accept: re-verifies status/validity/ownership; **atomically creates the order + moves RFQ → approved**; expired → 422, wrong owner → 403, double accept → 409 |
| POST | `/quotes/{id}/reject` | buyer (owner) | reject with reason |
| POST | `/quotes/{id}/request-revision` | buyer (owner) | back to staff |
| GET | `/quotes/{id}` | scoped | detail |

Quote statuses: `draft → sent → (accepted | rejected | revision_requested | expired | withdrawn)`.
Incoterms: FOB | CIF | DDP | EXW.

### 7.9 Orders (`/api/v1/orders/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/orders` | buyer (own) / staff | list |
| GET | `/orders/{id}` | owner/staff/admin | detail |
| PATCH | `/orders/{id}/status` | staff/admin | status change (`pending → confirmed → in_production → ready_to_ship → shipped → delivered`, or `cancelled`) |

Order numbers: `EGT-ORD-2026-000001` (yearly-sequential).

### 7.10 Shipments (`/api/v1/shipments/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST, GET | `/shipments` | staff/admin POST · scoped GET | create / list |
| GET, PATCH | `/shipments/{id}` | scoped | detail / status |
| POST | `/shipments/{id}/events` | staff/admin | append timeline event (status, location, note) |

Statuses: `booked → picked_up → in_transit → customs → out_for_delivery →
delivered`, plus `exception`. Shipment numbers: `EGT-SHP-2026-000001`.
Needs-from-Sukh: confirm the shipment-status vocabulary + exception semantics
before production (flagged during build).

### 7.11 Documents (`/api/v1/documents/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/documents/upload` | auth | multipart upload; 10 MB cap; MIME allowlist (pdf, jpg/jpeg, png, webp, doc/docx, xls/xlsx, csv, txt); stored **outside the web root** with random UUID filenames |
| GET | `/documents/{id}/download-url` | owner/staff/admin | returns **HMAC-signed, 15-minute** download URL |
| GET | `/documents/download` | via signed token | streams the file after token verification |

Document kinds: `rfq_attachment`, `quote_attachment`, `order_document`,
`shipment_document`, `compliance`, `other`. Per-document authorization is
checked server-side on both endpoints. Signed-URL round-trip/expiry/tamper
behaviour is unit-tested.

### 7.13 Support tickets (`/api/v1/support/*`)

| Method | Path | Access | Notes |

| POST, GET | `/support/tickets` | auth | open / list own |

| GET | `/admin/overview` | admin | dashboard widgets (**empty states only — no placeholder stats**) |
| GET | `/admin/users` | admin | user list |

without API support):** TOTP MFA, idle-lock screen, password re-auth before

text. The admin dashboard signs out after 15 minutes idle instead of locking.

## 8. Response schemas: explicitly absent

The spec publishes **zero response content schemas** (verified 2026-09-25 by
parsing `openapi.yaml`: 63 paths, 76 operations, 0 operations with a response
`content.schema`). Request DTOs are declared; nothing about what comes back is.

Consequences, flagged `UNDECLARED-RESPONSE-SHAPE` in the admin client
(`apps/admin/src/api/types.ts`):

1. **Auth token response** — spec guarantees only "an access token + rotating
   refresh token"; clients assume `{ accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }`.
2. **List envelope** — spec says "paginated" but the envelope is undeclared;
   clients must accept both arrays and `{ data, page, limit, total }`-style
   objects (admin `getPaged` normalises both).
3. **Every entity shape** (`User`, `Rfq`, `Quote`, `Order`, `Shipment`,
   `Document`, `Notification`, `Conversation`, `Message`, `SupportTicket`,
   `Dashboard` widgets, `Session`, `Tokens`) — field names are **best-effort
   guesses** in the admin client; they must be re-verified against live responses
   before production.
4. **Inline sub-resources** — the spec returns the shipment event timeline and
   ticket conversation inline with the detail object (per admin notes); clients
   should tolerate them arriving as separate endpoints instead.
5. **Message/reply DTOs** — only `body` is declared on send.

**Action before production:** either publish response schemas in the YAML
(preferred) or lock the client types against a live staging API. Until then,
clients must fail soft on unexpected shapes (empty states, never crashes).

## 9. Request examples

```bash
# Register (creates a BUYER even if role:"admin" is sent)
curl -X POST https://api.eaglegoodstrading.com/api/v1/auth/register \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"buyer@example.com","password":"Strong#Pass123","fullName":"Aman Buyer"}'

# Login → token pair
curl -X POST https://api.eaglegoodstrading.com/api/v1/auth/login \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"email":"buyer@example.com","password":"Strong#Pass123"}'

# Authenticated call
curl https://api.eaglegoodstrading.com/api/v1/rfqs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>"

# Submit an RFQ
curl -X POST https://api.eaglegoodstrading.com/api/v1/rfqs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"contactName":"Aman Buyer","contactEmail":"buyer@example.com","contactPhone":"+919876609948",
       "destinationCountry":"Canada","currency":"USD","requirementDetails":"Need 500L dishwash, private label",
       "items":[{"productId":"<uuid>","quantity":500,"unit":"L"}]}'
```

*(Hostnames are placeholders — no server exists there yet.)*
